basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Institute Departmental Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The AETS Lab, Mehta Family School of Sustainability, IIT Indore has invited applications for the Institute Departmental Postdoctoral Fellow (IDPF) position. The fellowship is Rs. 58,000/- + HRA (as per institute norms) for an initial 12 months, and the essential qualification is a Ph.D. in Biosciences, Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering, Biology, Biotechnology, Environmental Sciences and Engineering or allied fields. Applications are made through the application form linked in the notice, with the last date 17:00 hrs on 29 November 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed online at

how_to_apply: Interested candidates are requested to apply by filling the application form linked in the notice. The form must be submitted by 17:00 hrs on 29 November 2026. The notice names no other documents or steps.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview. The PI shall not be responsible for email delay, or any other reason for non-receipt of the document at the specified time, which will result in disqualification/rejection of the application. The selected candidate must join duty immediately upon receipt of the offer.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice also lists as desirable: working experience with extensive field surveys and data analysis through spreadsheets, report writing and presentation preparation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in Biosciences/Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering/Biology/Biotechnology/Environmental Sciences and Engineering or allied fields
rows.desirable: Relevant research experience in microbiology, water monitoring, instrument handling (Stereomicroscope, FTIR, GCMS)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 58,000/- + HRA (as per institute norms). The initial appointment is for 12 months. The fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance to date is not deemed satisfactory. The appointment is governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/funding agency applicable to the said project as and when required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore IDPF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 17:00 hrs on 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for the IIT Indore Institute Departmental Postdoctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Ph.D. in Biosciences/Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering/Biology/Biotechnology/Environmental Sciences and Engineering or allied fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the fellowship amount for the IDPF post?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 58,000/- + HRA (as per institute norms).

faq.question: Q4. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 58,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: The notice prints the fellowship as Rs. 58,000/- + HRA (as per institute norms), so HRA is mentioned in addition to the amount.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Indore IDPF position?
faq.answer: Candidates apply by filling the application form at the Google Forms link given in the notice, by 17:00 hrs on 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates attend an online interview at 11:00 AM on 4 December 2026, and the decision of the selection committee is final.

faq.question: Q7. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. For how long is the IDPF appointment?
faq.answer: The initial appointment is for 12 months. The fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice before the tenure ends if performance is not deemed satisfactory.
